<!doctype html>
<html lang="ko">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover,user-scalable=no">
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#100904">
  <title>전설의 대장간</title>
  <style>*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;min-height:100%;background:#080503;color:#fff4db;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,"Noto Sans KR",sans-serif}body{overflow:hidden}button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer}button:disabled{cursor:default;opacity:.48}h1,h2,p{margin:0}
#app{height:100dvh;min-height:620px;max-width:520px;margin:auto;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background-image:linear-gradient(#120a06cc,#080503dd),url(data:image/jpeg;base64,);background-size:cover;background-position:center}
#resourceBar{height:62px;padding:7px 10px;display:flex;gap:5px;align-items:center;background:#160d09ed;border-bottom:1px solid #855020}#resourceBar h1{font:900 18px Georgia,serif;color:#ffd875;line-height:1.05;margin-right:auto;max-width:105px}.resource-pill{background:#080504e8;border:1px solid #6d4321;border-radius:10px;padding:6px 7px;font-size:10px;white-space:nowrap}.resource-pill b{font-weight:800}
#levelCard{position:absolute;top:69px;left:15px;right:15px;height:50px;padding:8px 10px;background:#1b100be8;border:1px solid #8b5727;border-radius:12px;font-size:12px}#powerValue{float:right;color:#ffe1a6}#levelProgress{height:5px;margin-top:6px;border-radius:9px;background:#402718;overflow:hidden}#levelProgress i{display:block;width:14%;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#f77717,#ffe06b)}
#orderStrip{position:absolute;top:125px;left:15px;right:15px;height:54px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:5px}.order-mini{min-width:0;padding:5px 4px;border:1px solid #7f5229;border-radius:10px;background:#20130ce8;color:#efd5aa;font-size:10px;overflow:hidden}.order-mini small{display:block;margin-top:2px;font-size:9px;color:#bfa98c;white-space:nowrap}.order-mini.ready{border-color:#d7aa4b;box-shadow:0 0 10px #d68b2a55;color:#ffe095}
#regionButton{position:absolute;top:185px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:4;border:1px solid #91602b;background:#160d08dc;color:#ffd67c;border-radius:14px;padding:6px 13px;font-size:10px}
#forgeStage{position:absolute;top:205px;left:18px;right:18px;bottom:278px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center}.forge-overlay{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 72%,#ff8b233f,transparent 55%);pointer-events:none}.forge-overlay:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:0;width:155px;height:66px;transform:translateX(-50%);background:linear-gradient(#69666b,#28262a);clip-path:polygon(17% 0,83% 0,100% 30%,73% 40%,67% 100%,33% 100%,27% 40%,0 30%);filter:drop-shadow(0 7px 8px #000)}#hammer{position:relative;z-index:2;font-size:64px;transform:translateY(-42px);text-shadow:0 0 16px #ff8f24}#sparks{position:absolute;z-index:3;left:50%;bottom:57px;color:#ffd469;font-size:24px;text-shadow:0 0 12px #ff7b00}
#resultCard{position:absolute;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);bottom:205px;width:184px;min-height:128px;padding:9px 12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;background:linear-gradient(#091725f0,#070c13f5);border:2px solid #b7b7b7;border-radius:15px;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 0 16px #0008}#resultRarity{font-size:13px}#resultWeapon{font-size:40px;line-height:1.15;margin:3px 0}#resultName{font-size:15px}#resultValue{font-size:10px;color:#cbbba0;margin-top:3px}
#craftProgress{position:absolute;left:34px;right:34px;bottom:148px;height:43px;padding:7px 10px;background:#130b08e9;border:1px solid #795027;border-radius:12px;text-align:center}#craftStatus{font-size:10px;color:#edd5ae}.progress-track{height:7px;margin-top:5px;background:#3b2718;border-radius:9px;overflow:hidden}.progress-track i{display:block;width:0;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ff861b,#ffe269);transition:width .08s linear}
#collectionButton{position:absolute;left:18px;bottom:88px;width:88px;height:48px;border:1px solid #91602b;border-radius:15px;background:#23150ce8;color:#ffd983;font-size:11px}
#craftButton{height:52px;position:absolute;left:116px;right:18px;bottom:86px;border:2px solid #ffe2a0;border-radius:17px;background:linear-gradient(#ffd751,#df790f);color:#4a2100;font-size:18px;font-weight:900;box-shadow:0 0 18px #ff8a1788}
#bottomNav{height:74px;position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:4px;padding:7px;background:#130c08f4;border-top:1px solid #805024}#bottomNav button{border:1px solid #52351e;border-radius:11px;background:#26170e;color:#c8b79f;font-size:10px}#bottomNav button span{display:block;font-size:17px;color:#cdaa70;margin-bottom:2px}#bottomNav button.active{border-color:#e3a64a;color:#ffe1a6;background:#37210f;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #965c27,0 0 9px #dd812631}
#screenPanel,.overlay-panel{position:absolute;z-index:30;top:68px;left:12px;right:12px;bottom:82px;padding:14px;overflow:auto;background:#140d09fa;border:1px solid #9c682f;border-radius:17px;box-shadow:0 12px 28px #000b}.overlay-panel{z-index:45}#screenPanel h2,.overlay-panel h2{color:#ffd77c;margin-bottom:12px}.panel-close{float:right;border:0;background:#5d3519;color:#ffe1ad;border-radius:9px;padding:7px 10px}.order-card,.upgrade-card,.staff-card,.shop-card{margin:8px 0;padding:10px;background:#26170e;border:1px solid #5e3b20;border-radius:11px}.order-card b,.upgrade-card b,.staff-card b,.shop-card b{display:block}.order-card small,.upgrade-card small,.staff-card small,.shop-card small{display:block;color:#c1aa89;margin:4px 0 7px}.order-card button,.upgrade-card button,.staff-card button,.shop-card button,.collection-rewards button,.region-card{border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:7px
